children.game_version: A rhythmic game using bamboo sticks to tap out the beat.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the stick movements while seated, focusing on arm and wrist rhythm.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the stick movements without the hopping, focusing on upper body synchronization.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Holding sticks, swords, or rifles; moving them up and down synchronously.
movement_profile.footwork: Hopping from one foot to another.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two rows of dancers facing each other.

signature_moves.description: Women tossing their long hair from side to side.
signature_moves.name: Naash

signature_moves.description: Moving bamboo sticks up and down synchronously with the drum rhythm.
signature_moves.name: Stick movement

music_profile.sound_description: A percussive, rhythmic soundscape driven by drums and cymbals, layered with melodic flute or bagpipe lines and communal chanting.

basic_steps: Stand in two parallel rows facing the opposite line.
Hold a bamboo stick in the right hand.
Synchronize head and stick movements with the drum beat.
Hop lightly from one foot to the other in time with the rhythm.
teaching.formation: Two rows of dancers facing each other.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner: Focus on rhythmic stick movement. Intermediate: Incorporate the hop and synchronized head movement.
